capabilitiesMatrix.notes: Answers cite exact [source:<id>#rN] or [source:help:<id>#vN] markers; citations resolved against authorized sources.
Queries without matching context return ABSTAIN: insufficient authorized sources rather than fabricating facts.
Cross-workspace retrieval, proposal updates, confirmations, or cancellations fail closed with 403/404.
Excluded when contentScope.journal is false; asking to draft prompts settings opt-in guidance.
isVaultAiTarget rejects all vault targets with HTTP 403 vault_excluded / AI_VAULT_FORBIDDEN.
AbortSignal aborts provider HTTP transport; user draft retained; no orphaned background operations.
Token reservations tracked in DB; exceeding budget throws HTTP 429 AI_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.
Relative dates ('yesterday', 'tomorrow') without ISO YYYY-MM-DD trigger clarification questions; zero unreviewed writes.
PATCH /v1/ai/proposals/:id updates payload, re-hashes request, and issues fresh single-use confirmation token.
Save/Confirm executes proposal, writes to domain tables, records durable mutation receipt (AI_DEVICE_ID), returns deep link.
Re-confirming returns existing entity without duplication; cancellation writes zero rows.
DAYNORI_ASSISTANT_KILL_SWITCH halts with 503; workspace toggle disables; UI gating banner displayed.
